newsitem.title: ITALY: Benetton to make major announcement Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Benetton to make major announcement Tuesday.

text.p: Italian clothing group Benetton said it had called a news conference for 1000 GMT on Tuesday in Milan to make an "important announcement."
Benetton said in a statement that chairman Luciano Benetton as well as other managers would be present but gave no details as to the nature of the announcement.
Benetton group shares were 1.92 percent up at 26,750 lire at 1025 GMT, outperforming Milan bourse indices.

Dealers said the announcement might concern the much speculated sale of sports equipment company Benetton Sportsystem, owned like the Benetton group by the Benetton family's Edizione Holding, to the Benetton group itself.
